title: Maxim Integrated (Analog Devices) MAX30102 datasheet 19-7740 Rev 1 (10/18), 32 pages: distributor-hosted copy (MikroElektronika) of the ADI document
note: Manufacturer document (footer 19-7740; Rev 1; 10/18, PDF created 2018-11-05) served from a distributor host. The canonical copy, src_datasheet_adi, could not be fetched from this machine; this copy is the one read.
supports: p.1 general description: 1.8 V VDD supply, separate 3.3 V LED supply, I2C-compatible interface, software shutdown; features: 5.6 x 3.3 x 1.55 mm 14-pin optical module with integrated cover glass, 0.7 uA shutdown typ, -40 to +85 C

p.2 absolute maximum ratings (VDD -0.3 to +2.2 V; GND to PGND -0.3 to +0.3 V; VLED+ to PGND -0.3 to +6.0 V; all other pins -0.3 to +6.0 V; +-20 mA continuous into any terminal; HBM 2.5 kV; latchup +-250 mA; 440 mW at 70 C derate 5.5 mW/C; junction +90 C; storage -40 to +105 C; reflow +260 C)
p.2 package information: 14 OESIP, package code F143A5MK+1, outline 21-1048, theta-JA 180 C/W, theta-JC 150 C/W
p.2 electrical characteristics: VDD 1.7/1.8/2.0 V; VLED+ 3.1/3.3/5.0 V; IDD 600 uA typ / 1200 uA max in SpO2 and HR mode and IR-only mode (PW 215 us, 50 sps); ISHDN 0.7 uA typ / 10 uA max
p.3 ADC 18 bits; ADC clock 10.32/10.48/10.64 MHz; integration time 69/118/215/411 us; cover glass hydrolytic resistance class HGB 1 (DIN ISO 719)

p.4 IR LED 870/880/900 nm, VF 1.4 V, 6.5 mW at 20 mA; red LED 650/660/670 nm, VF 2.1 V, 9.8 mW at 20 mA; photodetector 600-900 nm, radiant sensitive area 1.36 mm2 (1.38 x 0.98 mm); die temperature sensor +-1 C, -40 to 85 C, 29 ms; SCL/SDA VIH >= 0.7 x VDD, VIL <= 0.3 x VDD, hysteresis 0.2 V, leakage +-0.05/+-1 uA; SDA/INT VOL <= 0.2 V at 6 mA
p.5 I2C write address 0xAE, read 0xAF; fSCL 0-400 kHz; bus capacitance 400 pF max
p.8 pin configuration (pin 1/14 end SENSOR, pin 7/8 end LED) and pin description (N.C. 1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 14; SCL 2; SDA 3; PGND 4; VLED+ 9, 10; VDD 11; GND 12; INT 13)
p.9 sample rate 50-3200 sps; LED current 0-50 mA; pulse width 69-411 us; ADC full scale 2-16 uA
p.18-20 tables 4-8: mode control, ADC range, sample rate, pulse width, LED current (0x1F 6.2 mA, 0x3F 12.6 mA, 0xFF 51.0 mA typ)
p.28 power-up sequencing (VDD before VLED+; INT and I2C pins may be pulled up while unpowered); power-down tolerant of any sequence; SDA open-drain, pull-up > 500 ohm; SCL input only
p.29 table 17: 7-bit slave ID 0b1010111 (0x57)

p.31 typical application circuit (VLED+ +3.3 V 200 mA max with 10 uF + 0.1 uF; VDD +1.8 V 20 mA with 4.7 uF + 0.1 uF; 1 kohm pull-ups to VDDIO; N.C. pins not connected); ordering information MAX30102EFD+T, -40 to +85 C, 14-lead OESIP (0.8 mm pin pitch), + lead-free, T tape and reel
p.32 revision history: Rev 1 (10/18) updated pin description, pin configuration and absolute maximum ratings
